description: This file defines an immutable implementation of the Resource interface, providing methods to create and manipulate resource objects with associated permissions, including JSON serialization/deserialization logic.

classes.name: ImmutableResource
classes.description: An immutable class implementing the Resource interface, representing a resource with a key and permissions, with methods for JSON conversion.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a Resource instance from a ResourceKey and a JsonValue containing permissions.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a Resource instance from a ResourceKey and specified EffectedPermissions.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a Resource instance from a JsonObject, extracting ResourceKey and permissions.

methods.name: getResourceKey
methods.description: Returns the ResourceKey of the resource.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the resource type derived from the ResourceKey.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path of the resource.

methods.name: getFullQualifiedPath
methods.description: Returns the full string path of the resource.

methods.name: getEffectedPermissions
methods.description: Returns the permissions affected by this resource.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the resource to a JsonObject according to a schema version.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code of this resource.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the resource.
